RAW_arm_definition: All neural arms use TRAIN input normalization and output restoration; RAW uses physical output loss, SCALED uses output-scale-normalized loss.
ridge_definition: TRAIN_RIDGE_FULL_PROGRAM is an action-conditioned linear dynamics world model, not a no-dynamics rule.
current_model_scope: 1614 causal features to 16x8 multi-horizon TCP/finger response; not a recursively complete environment state model.
limits: One T06 layout, four fresh native restarts; no independent-scene generalization claim.
NO_FUTURE_ACTION still observes real past execution history; later-window performance is not proof that actions are unimportant. FIRST_INSTALL is reported separately.
Different live inputs may produce different raw proposals; these are not exact counterfactual dynamics forks.
Only the one actually installed candidate per run supplies physical labels; other candidate scores are estimates.
next: Fresh original-owner finite scopes for the preregistered DIRECT / TRAIN_LINEAR / primary SCALED physical reference comparison.
